doc: Share of the variance lost by a 2x2 box average brought back bilinearly (rows clamp, columns wrap): the image is converted to float64 first, then every step is float64 (floor, clip, bilinear lerp, population variance), so a port is within 1e-9 (numpy against exactly rounded math.fsum sums: < 5e-16 relative). A texel checkerboard, the finest detail there is: every 2x2 block averages to 0.5.
